lines.text: Bel and Nebo crouch, their idols weigh down beasts and cattle, and the gods themselves go into captivity.
The LORD says He has carried the house of Jacob since birth and will bear them up when they turn gray.
People hire a goldsmith to make a god, then carry it on their shoulders to a crown, where it stands.

wrong_details.wrong: carry it on their shoulders to a crown
wrong_details.true: lift it to their shoulder and set it in its place

lines.text: The LORD says there is no other God, and He summons a lion from the east for His purpose.
The LORD says His righteousness and salvation are near, and He will grant salvation to Zion and adorn Israel with splendor.
